messages:
anna_partnerships: FYI — marketplace PO 789123 landed but vendor portal rejected it. says bank details mismatch. can someone take?

devin_sales: pulling it up. which marketplace? Azure Marketplace?

anna_partnerships: yes Azure. vendor did a hardware+support bundle for Edge GPUs. PO shows vendor name 'NovaEdge LLC' but portal expects 'Nova Edge Inc'.

vendor-bot: [system] PO 789123 ingestion failed: bank_account_verification = false. mismatch between submitted payee name and bank record. error_code: BANK_NAME_MISMATCH.

michael_finance: Bank verification mismatch usually blocks payment. We need vendor-signed bank attestation or corrected legal name on PO.

carmen_legal: Also seeing their signed SOW refers to 'Nova Edge, Inc.' while the PO is 'NovaEdge LLC' — we can't route until entity matches MSA. Do we have their W-9 or EU VAT?

kevin_ops: Marketplace requires entity to match marketplace listing metadata. If they want to keep LLC we have to update listing, which is slow. Short path: ask vendor to submit corrected PO and bank form.

devin_sales: I'll ping vendor now. @anna_partnerships can you attach the PO and the acceptance email?

anna_partnerships: attaching snippet of PO below:
```
PO: 789123
Vendor: NovaEdge LLC
Amount: $312,000
Payment terms: Net30
BankName: First National Bank
AccountName: NovaEdge LLC
AccountNumber: ****5678
```

carmen_legal: If their bank records show 'Nova Edge, Inc.' we need either (1) corrected PO with matching name + signed addendum, or (2) vendor letter + bank statement showing LLC as DBA of Inc. Legal prefers corrected PO.

devin_sales: Message sent to vendor rep (cc'd contracts). asking for corrected PO w/in 24h. vendor replied: "we used legacy template, will re-issue but takes 2-3 business days."

michael_finance: 2-3 days pushes invoice/payment schedule. can we do provisional approval in marketplace so their SKU doesn't get unpublished?

kevin_ops: Marketplace unpublish usually happens only if metadata expired. This is a billing ingest fail, not a listing fail. We can keep SKU live but mark the deal as payment-contingent. ops will add a note.

carmen_legal: I'll prepare a minimal addendum template they can sign to speed it up (one-line entity correction + attest). saving time > full MSA redline.

anna_partnerships: great. action items: devin follow up vendor for corrected PO (owner), carmen prepare addendum template (owner), michael prepare temporary payment hold note and update finance tracker (owner), kevin add marketplace ingest note (owner).

devin_sales: on it — pinging @NovaEdge rep again. will update thread. :thumbsup:

vendor-bot: [system] ticket created: FIN-PO-2026-789123 for manual review.

anna_partnerships: thanks everyone. i'll loop in AM for exec visibility if vendor delays beyond 48h.
